title: File:Truvada for PrEP HIV Prevention Prescription Pill Bottle (48610088067).jpg
art: Tony Webster from Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States
desc: Truvada for PrEP, an HIV antiretroviral drug taken by HIV-negative persons in at-risk communities like people in relationships with partners who are HIV-positive or have an unknown status, to prevent an HIV infection. Taken daily, it can be about 99% effective in combination with safe sex practices.
